high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for a book titled "If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies: Why Superhuman AI Would Kill Us All" by Eliezer Yudkowsky & Nate Soares. The book cover is prominently displayed in the center of the image, with a black background and bold white and red text. The title of the book is written in large, uppercase letters, with the subtitle "Why Superhuman AI Would Kill Us All" in a slightly smaller font below it. The authors' names, Eliezer Yudkowsky & Nate Soares, are also displayed at the bottom of the cover.
